mentions.name: Refresh Agent
mentions.description: This AI agent acts as a Marketing Strategist for SEO and marketing analysis. It connects Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Search Console data, answers plain-language questions like "why is my SEO traffic down this week" with clear answers based on the site's performance data, and provides a checklist of improvements to grow traffic.
mentions.problem: Figuring out what's working with your marketing and what to do next to grow using GA4 and Google Search Console can be frustrating.
mentions.audience: Marketing teams and site owners who analyze performance with GA4 and Google Search Console
mentions.source_excerpt:
Refresh Agent is an AI Agent for SEO and Marketing Analysis.

If you've ever tried to use Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Search Console (GSC) to figure out what's working with your marketing, and what to do next to grow, you have probably got frustrated at some point.

It acts as a Marketing Strategist. You can ask questions like "why is my SEO traffic down this week" and it will give you a clear answer based on your site's performance data, as well as a checklist to improve.
